results.title: Goldfinch and Fablemill Launch Global South Creative Economy Platform - Variety
results.content: # Goldfinch International and Fablemill Launch Creative Economy Advisory Platform Targeting Global South (EXCLUSIVE). Goldfinch International and Fablemill have formed a strategic advisory partnership aimed at governments, sovereign wealth funds and institutional investors developing creative economies across MENA, Asia and Africa. The platform is structured around four disciplines: government policy and incentive design, institutional investment advisory, local creative enterprise development and go-to-market support for international entrants. Goldfinch International – the advisory and ecosystem-building arm of Goldfinch, a London-based independent film finance and production group – brings a structured finance track record of more than $300 million deployed across 300-plus projects, a 0% default rate and an 11%–13% internal rate of return. During the Cannes Film Festival, Goldfinch International and Fablemill will co-host a private gathering at the harbor convening senior figures from film commissions, government advisory bodies, fund managers, studios and technology founders across MENA, Southeast Asia, Africa and South Asia.

results.title: Clinch Resources Ltd. Announces Change of Auditor - TradingView
results.content: # Clinch Resources Ltd. Announces Change of Auditor. - May 1, 2026) - Clinch Resources Ltd. CCLCH (the "**Company**") today announced that it has changed its auditor from Stern & Lovrics LLP, Chartered Professional Accountants, to Coulter & Justus, P.C., effective April 30, 2026. The change was made in connection with the completion of the Company's reverse takeover transaction, as announced in its news release dated March 18, 2026. The Company is relying on an exemption from the change of auditor requirements set out in Section 4.11(3) of NI 51-102 - *Continuous Disclosure Obligations* and in this regard confirms that there were no reportable events between the Company and Stern & Lovrics LLP. Clinch Resources Ltd. is a Tennessee-based metallurgical mining company with its corporate office located in Knoxville, Tennessee and operations in West Virginia. **For more information:Clinch Resources Ltd.:**Robert L. **Investor Relations Inquiries:Skyline Corporate Communications Group, LLC**Scott Powell, President.
